## Topics
- Why write functions
- Function arguments and defaults
- Iterating with across() and purrr::map()
- Reading and combining many files

## Learning objectives
By the end of this week you should be able to:

- Write a function that removes repeated code
- Apply a summary across many columns with across()
- Read a folder of files into one data frame

## Data
NHANES; a folder of county-level files (built for the course)
